title: Yoon's Martial Arts School

services.name: Jiu Jitsu
services.desc: When people hear the word "dojo," they often picture a Japanese martial arts school. But here at Yoon's Martial Arts, we proudly call our space a dojang. This small difference in words carries a big meaning. It reflects our deep respect for Korean martial arts traditions and the values we teach every day. Let me take you on a journey to understand why we are a dojang, not a dojo, and what makes Yoon's Martial Arts special in Calgary. A dojang is a Korean term for a martial arts training hall. It is where students gather to learn, practice, and grow in arts like Taekwondo, Hapkido, and other Korean styles. The word "dojang" means "place of the way," emphasizing the path of discipline,

You will meet new friends, get into great shape and feel empowered.
